title: MNEMOS Project Phase
description: Current phase + history for a project. Lives at <project>/.phase.json. Read by statusline, SwiftBar plugin, and Obsidian vault panel.

phase.description: Current operating phase for this project.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the current phase began. Used to compute 'how long have we been in this phase.'

ticket.description: Active Jira ticket for the current phase. Format: PROJ-123. Null if no specific ticket.

previous.description: History of prior phases for this project. Append on each transition.

notes.description: Optional free-text notes about the current phase. Surfaced in vault panel only, not statusline.
